elements.content:
Mike: Mom, hurry up! I’m going to be late.

Mom: Look, it’s a red light now. We must wait until

the green light is on. Safety comes first.

Mike: Oh, that car ran a red light. That driver

disobeyed the traffic rules.

Mom: The police will punish the driver.

Mike: Mom, there is an old man who wants to cross

the road. Let’s go and help him.

Mom: OK, watch out for the cars.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

child_list.content: 过马路
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
迈克：妈妈，快点！我要迟到了。

妈妈：看，现在是红灯了。我们必须等到

绿灯亮起。安全第一。

迈克：天哪，那辆车闯红灯了。那个司机

违反了交通规则。

妈妈：警察会处罚司机的。

迈克：妈妈，有个老人想过马路。我们去

帮他吧。

妈妈：好的，小心那些车。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
